official.deadline_note: No scholarship application or closing date is published. Consideration is automatic once an international applicant holds a full, unconditional Monash undergraduate offer; Monash accepts international (non-Year 12) admission applications for a place anytime throughout the year, with semester one starting early March and semester two mid-July.
official.application_cycle: Rolling consideration - international undergraduate admission applications are accepted year-round; four scholarships are offered per year.
official.status_note: The official scholarship page is live and publishing its current round: four scholarships are available per year and every international student holding a full, unconditional Monash undergraduate course offer is automatically considered.
official.tuition_coverage_note: 100% course fees paid until the minimum number of points for your degree are completed (excludes OSHC, accommodation and living costs).
benefits: 100% course fees paid until the minimum number of points for your degree are completed (excludes OSHC, accommodation and living costs).
Participation in the Campus Ambassador Program from your second semester of study.
Invitation to apply for a place in Monash Minds, a leadership program for first-year students.
eligibility: An international student - international students from all countries who have received an undergraduate course offer from Monash are automatically considered.
You must have received a full Monash course offer with no conditions.
You must intend to enrol full-time in an undergraduate degree at a Monash campus in Australia.

Not eligible: current Monash students; students studying an Australian Year 12 (see the Sir John Monash Scholarship for Excellence); students commencing the Bachelor of Medical Science and Doctor of Medicine (MD); students in Monash Pathway programs (e.g. Monash College and Monash University Foundation Year); students transferring from another Monash campus or applying to Monash from another Australian university.
requirements: You must have received a full Monash course offer with no conditions - a conditional offer does not qualify.
You must intend to enrol full-time in an undergraduate degree at a Monash campus in Australia.
To retain this scholarship you must maintain a Weighted Average Mark (WAM) of 70 each semester.
On request, you are required to provide a student profile for use in relevant Monash marketing, recruitment and promotional materials and/or events.
documents: Course code, course name, course start date and campus for the Monash undergraduate course applied for.
Copies of the documents specified in the course entry requirements (e.g. results, certificates, related employment).
Evidence you meet the English language requirements.
Official translations of documents in a language other than English.
Proof of payment of the AUD 125 international application fee.
selection_criteria: Four scholarships are available per year, drawn from the whole international undergraduate intake holding full, unconditional offers.
Automatic consideration only - no separate scholarship application, essay, interview or referee report is submitted.
coverage: 100% course fees paid until the minimum number of points for the degree are completed.
Excludes Overseas Student Health Cover (OSHC), accommodation and living costs.
application_method: No scholarship application is required; submit an international undergraduate admission application to Monash directly online or through an authorised Monash Education Agent.
Every student who holds a full, unconditional Monash undergraduate course offer is automatically considered for the scholarship.
Can be deferred within the same calendar year only.
official.application_route: No scholarship application exists - you apply for a Monash international undergraduate course (directly online or via an authorised Monash Education Agent) and are assessed automatically once you hold a full, unconditional offer.
official.citizenship_residency: International students from all countries; excludes current Monash students, students transferring from another Monash campus and applicants to Monash from another Australian university.
official.international_eligibility: Yes - open to international students from all countries; students studying an Australian Year 12 are excluded and directed to the Sir John Monash Scholarship for Excellence instead.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: All undergraduate study areas except the Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (Honours) and the Medical Science and Doctor of Medicine (MD); not available in Monash Pathway programs such as Monash College or Monash University Foundation Year.
official.duration: Duration of the undergraduate degree - 100% course fees are paid until the minimum number of points for the degree are completed.
official.description: Monash University automatically considers international students from all countries who have received an undergraduate course offer for the Monash International Leadership Scholarship. Recipients receive a 100% tuition sponsorship for the duration of their degree and the opportunity to develop learning and leadership skills as an ambassador for the University, with only four scholarships awarded each year.

applicant_utility.summary: This prize cannot be applied for - it is decided inside the Monash admission process, so the only thing you control is the strength of the application that wins you a full, unconditional offer. It erases your course fees for the whole degree but leaves Overseas Student Health Cover, accommodation and every living cost in Melbourne on your own budget. Selection is purely academic and only four awards exist for the entire international undergraduate intake, so treat it as a bonus on top of a solid funding plan rather than the plan itself. Aim to hold the unconditional offer well before the census date of your intended intake so the tuition sponsorship is in place when fees are charged.
applicant_utility.best_fit: High-achieving international school-leavers with an exceptional academic record applying directly to Monash for a full-time bachelor's degree at an Australian campus.
application_readiness_checklist: Lodge your Monash international undergraduate application (direct online, or through an authorised Monash Education Agent) early enough to receive a full, unconditional offer before the census date of your intake.
Sit an accepted English test or use an accepted English-medium route early - the offer is only 'full' once the English condition is cleared, and a conditional offer is not considered.
Get certified copies of your academic transcripts and results, plus a passport copy and official translations of anything not issued in English, and upload them with the application.
Pay the AUD 125 international application fee and attach proof of payment to the application.
Re-check your offer status in the applicant portal after each round and remediate any document request immediately, since the clock runs on the offer, not on a scholarship form.
Build a parallel funding plan for OSHC, accommodation and living costs, because none of it is covered by this award.
common_rejection_risks: Holding a conditional offer - only a full offer with no conditions is considered, so an outstanding transcript still misses out if a condition is outstanding.

Arriving through a Monash Pathway program (Monash College, Foundation Year or Monash Advanced Preparation Program) or transferring from another Monash campus or another Australian university, all of which are expressly excluded.
Applying as an Australian Year 12 or IB student through VTAC - those cohorts are pushed to the Sir John Monash Scholarship for Excellence instead.
Targeting the Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (Honours) or the Medical Science and Doctor of Medicine (MD), which are excluded courses.
Being one of hundreds of qualifying offer-holders for only four awards, so the margin between success and missing out can be a fraction of a mark.
Letting the semester WAM slip below 70 after award, which terminates the scholarship rather than suspending it.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Overseas Student Health Cover, accommodation and all living costs are expressly excluded and Monash publishes no stipend, travel or installation allowance with this award, so those costs must be met from your own funds, family support or another scholarship; the AUD 125 application fee is also yours to pay.
document_audit: Documents must be certified - an uncertified upload stalls the admission assessment, and no full offer means no scholarship consideration.
Every non-English document needs an official translation; Monash does not accept competency-based qualifications or subjects as evidence of English proficiency.
The application itself asks for course code, course name, start date and campus, so a mistake there misroutes the file that decides your scholarship.
Keep the passport bio page and the application-fee payment receipt attached to the submission rather than emailing them separately.
alerts: Deferral is only possible within the same calendar year, so a delayed start into the next year can cost you the award.
Retention is active, not automatic: a WAM of 70 every semester plus a willingness to supply a student profile for Monash marketing and recruitment on request.
You cannot hold this alongside another scholarship that also pays your course fees; if two fee-paying scholarships are offered, the higher-value one is retained.
Fee payments are processed after the census date for each teaching period, so plan your cash flow for the first weeks of semester before the credit lands.
There is no appeal or waitlist published for unsuccessful candidates, and no notification date is given for the four awards.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: You submit one international undergraduate admission application; Monash assesses eligibility and academic achievement internally across all qualifying offer-holders, and any award arrives with or after your course offer rather than through a separate scholarship submission.
